name: Kirkland Signature Organic Frozen Blueberries (Strained Smoothie Hack)
whyItWorks: Rich in anthocyanins and polyphenols shown to reduce gut inflammation. While eating whole raw berries passes insoluble skin flakes, high-speed blending or straining into a smooth beverage provides all the anti-inflammatory benefits without roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Blend completely in a high-powered blender with lactose-free almond milk or water until smooth. Strain through a fine mesh sieve if strictures are present.
